connector.name: SF Muni Real-Time Transit
connector.registryDescription: Real-time SF Muni departures, routes, alerts, vehicle positions, and schedules.
connector.summary: Hosted at muni-mcp.srivastsh.workers.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the srivastsh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
